contract: send_once(message, transport) must retry after a transient error, reuse the same idempotency key, and record success only after acknowledgement.
existing: transport is an owned boundary adapter; test suite already uses a fake transport that records external requests.
constraints: No network or real messages. User requests test-first implementation in a disposable workspace.
source:
def send_once(message, transport):
    return transport.send(message, key="new-key")
